pages.text: Although it is merely a waystone, it still bears the title of “Eternal” It can be used indefinitely in simple rituals and no longer needs to be crafted repeatedly. It also has a method of duplication, allowing you to give it to your fellow wizard companions, making it convenient for you to visit one another.
The Eternal Waystone can teleport all creatures within the ritual area to the coordinate point, but it will preserve the relative positions of all creatures to the altar.
